newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SMC A up 6.9 pct on stock conversion talk.
newsitem.headline: SMC A up 6.9 pct on stock conversion talk.

text.p: San Miguel Corp A gained three pesos, or 6.9 percent, to 46.50 pesos on Monday on newspaper reports last week that a major shareholder of the firm plans to convert its B shares into A shares, brokers said.

Reports in local newspapers last week that the United Coconut Planters Bank (UCPB) asked the court to convert into A shares the 209 million SMC B shares it holds in trust for small coconut farmers boosted the issue, said one local broker.

"If the court approves the planned conversion of the UCPB- held SMC B shares, which account for 11 percent of the total outstanding shares of SMC, this will create more demand for SMC A shares," said one local broker.
The UCPB-held shares were purchased through funds raised from a controversial coconut levy imposed during the regime of the late President Ferdinand Marcos, brokers said.
